method: Sequential fresh Chromium profiles; fixed source snapshots, batch size 3, concurrency 6, application cache disabled. Local recording relay forwards request bodies unchanged. Upstream load and prompt caching uncontrolled. Thirteen passing cases use d0f721c. Japanese 5k and 10k were rerun on 29ef304 after exact omitted-leaf recovery and a recording-relay parser fix; this is not a 15-case measurement on the final build.
change: Viewport-first bounded lookahead fills configured worker slots. Two batch/concurrency waves, up to 64 paragraphs and 48,000 source characters per root, with currently visible paragraphs always eligible. Scrolling drops obsolete unsent work; restore prevents late insertions.

results.error: Translation failed: Agent returned duplicate, missing or unknown item IDs.
Translation failed: Translation service returned HTTP 502. Check URL, model, credentials and quota.

failures.cause: Model omitted a leaf reference while supplying its translation as plain parent text; fixed by exact unique matching with full preservation revalidation.

Recording relay assumed translations was an array when model JSON used a different field; the relay threw before forwarding, producing an artificial 502. Fixed recorder forwards the original malformed JSON unchanged, allowing product recovery.

limitations: Single runs per case on Linux Chromium, not Mac/Safari/mobile timings or a latency SLA.
Only the 5k Chinese control was freshly rerun before this change; other before timings are historical.
Provider load and upstream prompt caching are uncontrolled; timings include a local recording relay except the direct short sample.
Same frozen article prefixes across languages; no paragraph, link or formatting removal.
Passing confirms paragraph completion, expected CJK script, original link/formatting multisets and exact restore, not sentence-level semantic accuracy.
No prompt, model, batch-size or concurrency-limit changes in this implementation.
